signature.one_line: Selfie talking head rotating with split face-card + UI mock-ups; UPPERCASE word-by-word captions with one white-boxed accent key phrase.
unique_devices: Three-layout rotation on nearly every cut: full-face selfie, split (rounded face card top 4-46 %, UI card below 56 %), full-screen white or accent UI explainer
Key phrase in a solid white rounded box with accent caps text, wiped in left-to-right over 2 frames, 5 frames after a small white lead-in word
Tools rebuilt as clean UI mock-ups (dot-grid off-white, mono labels, animated cursor, accent STEP tags) instead of raw screen recordings
Strike-through 'old method' card (grey button, accent X, tilted tag) and a gated CTA: padlock framework card + typed comment bar + keyword end-card pill
signature.why_it_works: Every cut changes the layout so the eye always gets something new; mock-ups make a technical method legible, and the boxed key phrase gives each sentence one anchor.

hook.type: direct address naming a pain + proof card
hook.first_frame: mirrored selfie medium close-up holding a mic, warm wall; above the head a white stat card proving the problem and a second accent-highlighted title label; caption building at ~76 % height

structure.what: name the pain in the first second over a stat card, then an animated mock-up of the tedious current method
'stop doing this': strike-through old-method card, then boxed key phrase introducing the easier way
credibility tag, an audience question card, a usage meter; boxed 'HOW' transition
numbered steps as UI mock-ups with STEP tags, cursor clicks and a before/after stat comparison
mechanism: table, node-link diagram and a accent concept card explain why it works
honest caveat with a ≠ statement card and a reasons table
gated lead magnet: locked framework card, typed comment keyword, accent end card with a keyword pill

pacing.notes: hard cuts only; 18 of 24 cuts mid-sentence (cut on caption phrases, not pauses); layout changes on 22 of 24 cuts; face shots 48-117 frames

captions.how: Inter 800 46 px white (accent on light layouts), centred at y 75.9 % on face shots / y ~48-50 % between cards on splits; each word hard-cuts on in place (line pre-laid out, grows right)
white #F9FDFD rounded box (r ~8 px) under a lead-in word, box y 77.7-84.1 %, accent Inter 800 88 px -0.04em; 2-frame left-to-right wipe; accent layouts invert to accent box + white text

background_text.what: hook title label on a second accent highlight bar
background_text.how: black heavy rounded type on second accent #BDF806 rectangle y 28-31 % above the head
accent Inter 800 74-86 px -0.04em, centre y ~14 %, word-by-word reveal; key words royal accent

motion_graphics.what: animated cursor clicks, check marks, bar fills, link-line draws, typing dots
motion_graphics.how: short eased moves (power2.out ~8-12 frames), elements swap inside a shot
grey button, accent X draws across, tilted 'OLD METHOD' tag drops in, small handwritten aside
nodes and connecting lines draw on accent or white

cards_lists.how: small accent mono 'STEP N · TOOL' tag at y ~64 % on each step
two cards 'small VS big' with large accent / accent numerals
white and accent pills with a accent ≠ between them

broll_inserts.what: UI mock-ups instead of screen recordings
broll_inserts.how: rebuilt light UI on #EEF4FB dot grid, white rounded cards, accent dark-mode for mechanism and CTA

layout.what: split: rounded face card over UI card
layout.how: face card x 8-92 %, y 4-46 %; caption in the gap at y ~48-50 %; UI card from y ~56 %

camera.how: motion comes from the UI animation, not the camera

transitions.how: cut on caption phrase boundaries; layout swaps with each cut

end_card.how: padlock framework card 'IN YOUR DM', comment bar typing the keyword at y ~90 %, accent end card with logo lockup and accent 'Comment "KEYWORD"' pill

captions_spec.script: latin; the speech is Hinglish but the captions are an ENGLISH TRANSLATION, so word sync is approximate (a Hinglish/Roman transliteration also works with the same system)

grouping.key_words_per_caption: 1-2 (one key phrase per sentence, on its own line under a 1-word lead-in)
grouping.sync: word by word: each word switches on in place roughly as its meaning is spoken
grouping.break: caption hard-cuts out (often a 1-frame gap) and the next phrase starts; layout changes on almost every picture cut

layout.face_shots: one line centred horizontally (x centre ~45-50 %), centre y 75.9 % (over the chest, under the chin/mic); a 5-word line spans ~x 13-74 %
layout.key_on_face: lead-in word small white centred at y 75.9 %, the boxed key phrase directly below: box x 27.4-72.6 %, y 77.7-84.1 % (centre y 80.9 %), text centre y 80.7 %
layout.split_layout: rounded face card on top (x 8-92 %, y 4-46 %), caption centred in the gap below it at y ~48-50 % (key box x 34-66 %, y 47.5-52.3 %), UI card below from y ~56 %
layout.graphic_layout: headline line at the top, centre y 13.7-14.3 %, laid out centred and revealed word by word (so partial lines look left-shifted)
layout.reveal_in_place: the full line is typeset at its final centred position first; words appear one by one at their final x, so the line grows to the right without re-centring

caption.letterform_evidence: flat-sided grotesque caps, S with horizontal terminals, straight-armed Y, W with apex at cap height, very tight spacing
caption.calibration_note: source 5-word caps line measured ink 1.8 % H (cap height); compute expected width for any test line with fit_font.py
caption.on_light_layouts: same size and weight in navy #0B1327 between the face card and the UI card (ink ~1.4 % H)

key.font_class: neo-grotesque sans, extra-bold, tight (same face as captions)
key.shadow: none on the text; the box has a very soft light glow on light layouts
key.box: solid white #F9FDFD rounded rectangle, radius ~8 px at 1080 (estimated), padding ~27 px left/right, ~24 px top, ~30 px bottom at 1080 (measured: text x 30.1-70.3 % inside box 27.4-72.6 %, text y 78.9-82.5 % inside box 77.7-84.1 %)
key.split_layout_size: smaller on split layouts: a single key word at ink 2.89 % H -> ~75 px in Inter 800 -0.04em
key.navy_variant: on navy #091E47 layouts the box inverts: royal-blue #1D50DB box with a thin white outline, white text
key.selection_rule: the noun phrase that names the idea of the sentence (the method, the 'how', the result word, the offer name)

headline.color: navy #0B1327 on white/light #EEF4FB layouts; royal blue #1F4FD6 for the key phrase; white on navy
headline.position: top of full-screen UI explainers, centre y 13.7-14.3 %
headline.fit_note: a 2-word blue key headline solved to 86 px; use 74-86 px depending on line length

animation.caption_entry: hard cut on, word by word, no fade/scale/slide; each word appears complete in one frame, ~4-12 frames apart
animation.key_entry: the lead-in word cuts on first; the boxed key phrase follows 5 frames later with a left-to-right wipe of box + text over 2 frames, no overshoot
animation.timing: translation captions: the word appears when its spoken equivalent is said; key phrase can lead the spoken word by ~5 frames
animation.exit: hard cut; usually a 1-frame empty gap before the next caption

captions_spec.notes: Positions, sizes, colours and frame timings measured on video frames; font names are closest matches (unverified); shadow and corner radius estimated.

other_text_spec.text: 'Headline here' black heavy rounded display type on a lime #BDF806 highlight rectangle (x ~13-90 %, y ~28-31 %) under a white stat card at the top (grey 'bad' count / green 'good' count) that proves the pain

white rounded cards with soft shadow on #EEF4FB dot-grid: mono uppercase labels (JetBrains-Mono-like, grey, ~1 % H, letter-spaced), navy pill buttons with white caps text, royal-blue #1F4FD6 accents, small blue mono 'STEP 1 · TOOL NAME' tags at y ~64 %

grey old-method button crossed by a blue X with a tilted 'OLD METHOD' tag and a small handwritten aside; 'small number VS big number' stat cards (big blue / navy numerals); 'X ≠ Y' caveat in white and navy pills with a blue ≠

locked framework card with a padlock and 'IN YOUR DM' (~280 frames), a social-style comment bar (white pill, '+ KEYWORD', blue 'Post') at y ~90 % typing the keyword, then a navy end card with the brand lockup and a royal-blue 'Comment "KEYWORD"' pill (~78 frames)

style.look_intent: high-contrast, muted, neutral-warm: warm lamp-lit face footage against cool off-white and navy graphics, so the two layers separate

sound.music: possible low music bed (gap level -22 dB vs speech); mood not inferable
sfx: click on cursor taps in UI mock-ups (optional)
no hits on hard cuts (measured cut_hit_share 0.21)
bed audible under the end card

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

catalog_styles.name: Screen-Plus-Facecam
catalog_styles.role: split face card over UI card

use_when: a how-to / hack about a software tool or workflow explained by one speaker
the user can rebuild the tool screens as clean mock-ups (or has screenshots to restyle)
the script has an old-way vs new-way turn and numbered steps
the CTA is a comment keyword / DM lead magnet
Hinglish or English speech with English on-screen text
avoid_when: no UI or process to show - pure opinion or story
the user wants a cinematic, face-first edit
no time to build ~10 mock-up graphics
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B19 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B19.json) to this brand.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour/font for each role; keep the contrast relationship: {{ACCENT}} text must stay >= 4.5:1 on its white box, captions >= 3:1 on the footage)
- {{TEXT}} caption text on footage - default #FFFFFF (navy #0B1327 on light layouts)
- {{ACCENT}} key-phrase text / headline key words / STEP tags - default royal blue #1F4FD6
- {{ACCENT_2}} hook title highlight bar - default lime #BDF806 (black text on it)
- {{SURFACE}} light UI background - default #EEF4FB with a faint dot grid; cards white with soft shadow
- {{CARD_BG}} dark-mode layout / end card - default navy #091E47 (key box inverts to an {{ACCENT}} box with a thin white outline and white text)
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}} captions, key box, headlines - default Inter 800 (ExtraBold)
- {{FONT_BODY}} UI mono labels - default JetBrains Mono, uppercase, letter-spaced, grey, ~1 % H
- {{HANDLE}} - @handle (end card, under the logo)
- {{LOGO}} - brand lockup on the navy end card

Canvas 1080x1920, 30 fps.

LAYOUT (rotate on almost every cut; only ~1 in 12 cuts keeps the same layout)
1. Full-face selfie MCU (~20 % of runtime, 48-117 frames per shot), static, no punch-ins.
2. Split (~36 %): rounded face card x 8-92 %, y 4-46 %; caption centred in the gap at y ~48-50 %; UI mock-up card from y ~56 % down on {{SURFACE}}.
3. Full-screen UI explainer (~44 %) on {{SURFACE}} (or {{CARD_BG}} for mechanism / CTA): headline at the top, centre y ~14 %, UI cards below with animated cursor, check marks, bar fills, link lines; blue 'STEP N · TOOL' mono tags at y ~64 %.

CAPTIONS
4. Latin script, UPPERCASE (English translation of Hinglish speech is fine). 1-6 words on ONE line, never wraps.
5. Caption: {{FONT_DISPLAY}} 46 px, {{TEXT}}, tracking 0, no stroke/box, faint shadow 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.35). Face shots: centred at y 75.9 %. Split shots: centred at y ~48-50 % (navy on light).
6. Reveal in place: typeset the full line centred first, then switch words on one by one at their final x (hard cut, no fade/scale), ~4-12 frames apart; hard cut out, then a 1-frame gap before the next caption.
7. Key phrase (one per sentence, the noun phrase that names the idea): small lead-in word in {{TEXT}} at y 75.9 %, then 5 frames later the key phrase in a solid white rounded box (r ~8 px, padding ~27 px L/R, ~24 px top, ~30 px bottom) at x 27.4-72.6 %, y 77.7-84.1 %, text {{ACCENT}} {{FONT_DISPLAY}} 88 px, tracking -0.04em, wiped left-to-right over 2 frames, no overshoot. On split layouts ~75 px. On {{CARD_BG}} layouts invert: {{ACCENT}} box, thin white outline, white text.
8. Explainer headline: {{FONT_DISPLAY}} 74-86 px, -0.04em, navy on {{SURFACE}} (key words {{ACCENT}}), centre y 13.7-14.3 %, revealed word by word in place.

OTHER TEXT / EDIT DEVICES
9. Hook frame 1: a white stat card proving the pain at the top + 'Headline here' in black heavy rounded type on an {{ACCENT_2}} bar at y 28-31 %; first cut at frame ~57 into an animated mock-up of the slow current method.
10. 'Stop doing this' beat: grey old-method button, {{ACCENT}} X drawing across, tilted 'OLD METHOD' tag, small handwritten aside.
11. Comparison: two stat cards 'small VS big' with large {{ACCENT}} / navy numerals; caveat as 'X ≠ Y' white and navy pills with an {{ACCENT}} ≠.
12. CTA (last ~19 %): locked framework card with padlock 'IN YOUR DM' (~280 frames), a comment bar (white pill, '+ KEYWORD', {{ACCENT}} 'Post') at y ~90 % typing the keyword, then {{CARD_BG}} end card with {{LOGO}}, {{HANDLE}} and an {{ACCENT}} 'Comment "KEYWORD"' pill (~78 frames).
13. Cuts: hard cuts only, on caption-phrase boundaries (mid-sentence is fine).

GRADE: Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: high-contrast, muted, neutral-warm face footage set against cool off-white and navy graphics.
SOUND: voice at about -14 LUFS, optional low bed under voice and end card, optional click on cursor taps.

VERIFY before rendering (px values were render-verified with Inter; if the brand font differs, adjust px until the numbers match):
a) Render test frames: "EASY WAY" ({{ACCENT}} in the white box, 88 px, -0.04em), "BECAUSE" (navy headline, 74 px, -0.04em on {{SURFACE}}), and "KEY WORD" as a caption line (46 px {{TEXT}} over a dark area).
b) Measure: python video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test render or snapshot> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.28,0.775,0.72,0.835 --ink "{{ACCENT}}:90" (key box); --box 0.15,0.11,0.85,0.165 --ink "#0B1327:80" (headline); --box 0.1,0.745,0.9,0.775 --ink "{{TEXT}}:60" (caption).
c) Required: "EASY WAY" ink 3.67 % +-0.5 of H and 40.1 % +-2 of W; "BECAUSE" 2.89 % +-0.5 and 30.4 % +-2; caption caps ink ~1.8 % H - compute the expected width of "KEY WORD" at 46 px with python video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py --font "<{{FONT_DISPLAY}}>" --word "KEY WORD". Box edges within +-1 % of the numbers above.
